author: HCDE
text:
Thanks, but what bugs me is that the engulf comes from a barrier (RS kink), and you enter on the next one (a LS kink).

In my mind, the engulf from the RS kink barrier is a proof that that kink is the right one, so why entering on that LS kink?

But writing that i also think of If saying: think about the diamond....
They can go further into the FL to make the diamond. I understand in
that way that you enter on a good LS kink, but then the question is
where is the end of the considered FL... That question i can't answer it
 right now.

I guess you allowed yourself to be aggressive with your stop because there wasn't clean orders above?

Anyway, thanks for your inputs, that's of great value
